answer: Every job enters a re-performance lottery. First, each epoch a random two percent of jobs go to a second agent who redo the work blind, decoding it like a cipher. Second, outputs are compared: a match earns both agents a bonus and lifts the first agent toward the zenith. Third, a mismatch slashes the first agent's stake and sends the case to three veterans. A farm of a thousand fake identities faces two hundred re-runs per epoch, about $4,000 a month in labour, while one honest agent pays nothing. A sybil swarm is a river of counterfeit work: wide and fast, but the re-checks dam it dry.
